title: You're in Tenochtitlan When Cortés Arrives, 1519 #history
description:
November 1519: Cortés enters the Aztec capital on its lake. Smallpox, a siege that cut the causeways and fresh water, and hunger. The city fell in August 1521. Told from inside the story, in under a minute.

Would you survive? Comment SURVIVE or DEAD.
